title: Perfume Noir — 3-shot commercial

P01.description: A black glass perfume bottle with a faceted gold cap and a flat cream label reading NOIR

constraints: Keep the label flat, sharp and readable.

shots.setting: A dark studio with a polished obsidian plinth
shots.action: A thin curl of mist drifts past the bottle and clears
shots.framing: Extreme close-up on the cap, eye level
shots.optics: 100mm macro look, shallow depth of field
shots.lighting: Single hard rim light from camera left, deep black background
shots.final: The cap fills the upper third of the frame
shots.sound: Low airy hum, a soft glass chime as the mist clears

shots.setting: The same dark studio and obsidian plinth
shots.action: The bottle stays still while light sweeps across the facets
shots.camera: Slow 90-degree orbit to the right at constant speed
shots.lighting: Moving soft rim light, controlled specular highlights

shots.setting: The same dark studio, now with a faint warm haze
shots.action: A woman's hand enters frame and lifts the bottle off the plinth
shots.lighting: Warm key from the right, soft fill
shots.final: Hero frame: bottle held at center, label readable
shots.sound: A soft glass tap, then silence
